A novice who just started to grasp the potential of his gift. His limited knowledge undermines the control over his magic.
A gifted archer fascinated by the nature of her concoctions, who decided to focus on the study of Thaumaturgy: replicating magic through scientific means.
Long forgotten by death itself, this Lich survived for eons in a remote corner of the realms, his powers over death growing to unfathomable strength.

Heralds of the Gods of Light, only the most exceptional and selfless healers can ascend through the divine ranks. They are said to operate in mysterious ways, and even to be able to bring back fallen soldiers from certain death.

The feared and revered leader of the Holy Temple, he shapes its doctrine and commands its followers. He must possess the strength to resist all forms of magical and political influence as he wages war against the very source of evil, defeating eldritch gods before they can tighten their hold on the human realms.
"Untrained in the art of combat, he possesses the spark of something he can't explain yet. Ever since he saw it, he searched for ways to improve his understanding."

Archangel are divine beings of pure light, embodying hope in the darkest corners of the Realms. Ancient chronicles tell of these powerful beings descending from the sky, restoring entire armies and turning the tide of decisive battles.
Armed with a bow and arrows, she provides reliable long-range support, delivering shots to hurt enemies from a distance.
Masters of deception, these individuals are often employed by noble families to discreetly remove troublesome opponents.
The unrestrained embodiment of Chaos, feared even by powerful Gods. This natural force wreaks havoc in the mortal lands as in the depths of hell, often having entire armies failing to stop its march.

A master entertainer who can play music to heal, harm, or drive soldiers into a holy fury. Used to resort to any means to survive, this traveling storyteller offensive capabilities should not be underestimated, either.

A Lich ascended to his ultimate form. Though his body remains a mere withered shell, the spirit of this dark mage has grown immensely powerful. He can wield magic to shape the world around him and summon horrors beyond imagination.

Fueled solely by his lust for power, this brilliant strategist has transformed his kingdom into a war machine, poised to subjugate neighboring states—whether opposing or neutral—to seize the resources needed for his expansion. With no regard for life and an insatiable hunger for dominance, he poses a grave threat to the peace and stability of the Realms if left unchecked.
Feared even by the most prepared armies, she can render a whole fortress defenseless with a few, accurate shots at its defending troops.

A legendary archer that defies the most basic laws of nature. Every arrow crackles with raw energy as it hits the target with extreme force, and her sole presence on the battlefield denies to entire armies the possibility of an open field attack.
After years of magic studies, the Cleric has a solid grasp of healing magic. He is a solid staple of any exploration team of adventurers.

The poison coursing through her veins has somehow mutated into an even more potent form without harming its host. This unique toxin is stronger, unlike any other, and can only exist through this rare symbiosis. When these creatures defy the law of the land, they are hunted relentlessly—and often, unsuccessfully.
Strong and nimble, he stealthily closes in on unsuspecting targets to strike them with considerable force.
A knight who has forsaken the path of law, now only loyal to his own principles.

Having abandoned the path of knowledge for that of corruption, this mage seeks power not through endless studies and practice, but through communion with evil beings trying to influence the world for their nefarious purposes.
Inspiring fear as he roams the lands, the Death Knight relentlessly obliterates any obstacle that lies in the path of his objectives.

"In the self-destructive path to become a master of the undead, the necromancer has to face power beyond the mortal's imagination, and resist their corruption. Flesh begins to decompose, as he realizes that the price to pay for the control over Death is eternal suffering."

Awakening from the initial torpor, the inhabitant of this body grasps the rules of this reality and breaks free from its cradle. It obeys no master, and its disgust for earthly creatures weakness only grows with time.

Untouchable by most conventional and magical weapons, this divine warrior wields a sword with lightning speed, deflecting both arrows and spells alike. He is the champion of choice to face any adversary, even those of divine power.

A duelist of unmatched skill in single combat, this warrior—born perhaps once in a generation—wields a sword so swift that his strikes are over before they’re even seen, cutting down opponents with imperceptible speed.
Only legendary riders could hope to ever tame a drake and learn how to ride it. This deadly duo will ignite the battlefield while hunting down the few survivors with deadly arrows.
An ethereal embodiment of divine melody, wielding godlike power to protect his allies, able to rally armies to reshape whole kingdoms.
"Transcending the border between mortal and divine, her potions incorporate an eldritch god's blessing, obtained through arcane means and without its knowledge."
A brilliant mind who devoted her life to the study of Thaumaturgy, she has successfully replicated elemental magic in her potions using only natural ingredients and chemical processes.
This masterful alchemist not only succeeded in harnessing the power of the elements in her creations but also infused them with blessings typically linked to benevolent deities.
A legendary warrior whose armor is unbreakable by conventional means. Able to duel with mortals and deities, able to withstand an unreal amount of damage before even flinching.
Amids the journey of discovery, the Fire Wizard learned to channel magic to emulate natural forces. Being the most dangerous of them all, he choose fire as the object of his studies.
A novice infantry unit. Lacks experience, but has received a brief training in the Royal Army.
With a rare mastery of the bow, she makes death rain on the battlefield in the form of the deadliest of arrows.

This fearsome archer rides one of the last remaining Golden Drakes, a nearly extinct subspecies of the more common drake. Distinguished by its brilliant golden scales, the Golden Drake boasts greater strength and a fiercer, hotter flame than its kin.
Specialized in the surveillance of civilians or places of interest, guards are widely employed for the protection of sensitive objectives.
Having developed an almost superhuman ability with her weapon, she hails arrows on enemy armies with such a speed that surviving is almost impossible
A divine musician able to change the fate of a war through his instrument. Not only he will empower his allies, but through a uniquely crafted music, he will make them immune to pain.
Half way between assassin and artist, he draws his target ever closer to death with each strike—leaving behind hauntingly beautiful tributes to Death itself in his wake.
A knight devoted to the service of the Holy Temple, he is a protector of the righteous and a vanguard of justice, sworn to eradicate evil from every corner of the land.
An archer who shifted the focus of her training to horse riding. Blends the danger of long-range attacks with the ability to deal melee damage with her ride.
Refining her skills with her hunting experience in the wilderness, she can hit enemies with reliable shots.
This archer of unnatural precision is a coveted asset for any army. She can fend off a full-scale assault for hours, and can be reached only by sacrificing an enormous number of soldiers.

"Ascending through infernal ranks through its ruthlessness and cruelty, an Infernal Lord walking the realms is a threat that brings enemy kingdoms together in a desperate effort to prevent the entire world's descent into chaos."

Rising from the ashes of conquest and tempered by the fires of countless battles, the Infernal Prince commands legions with a fearsome authority unmatched in the infernal realms. Now no longer a commander but a true sovereign of terror, the Infernal Prince stands as an unstoppable force, against whom resistance is little more than a fleeting hope.

An incredibly powerful, mystical able to invoke firestorms out of thin air, burning entire armies to ashes while meteor falls upon them. An army that can reliably protect him is an army that can win any battle.
"As feared as he is respected, the Inquisitor's might is rarely matched. He stands as the supreme lawgiver, overseeing the realms conquered by the Holy Temple."
An enormous warden capable of withstanding a substantial amount of damage before succumbing.
A seasoned guard rich in experience, clad in a heavy armor.
A rare sight in the battlefield, these armored giants can easily shrug off strikes from siege weapons with ease.

"The Justiciar serves as the Holy Temple’s arbiter, enforcing laws that everyone—from peasants to kings—must obey to avoid incurring the Temple's wrath. A formidable warrior, he leads crusades against evil tyrants and unholy creatures that threaten the Realms."
"The king's personal guard. Wreaks havoc during unrests, and singlehandedly guarantees His Majesty safety against any threat."
Renowned for their steadfast loyalty and honor, they provide a first line for their allies while overpowering their foes.

Through extraordinary willpower, the Lich endured his transformation for decades, without surrendering to the pain until only bare bones remained. Since muscles and tendons are long gone, this shell of a human is animated entirely by magic.
An inexperienced mage who tries to expand his knowledge towards a branch of magic that does not hurt foes, but help allies.
A demigod who mastered the control over death, capable of summoning terrifying monsters never seen before.
The stories known by this keeper of ancient wisdom are almost endless. Drawing upon myths and legends, he channels forgotten magic through his instrument notes.
Rigorous training coupled with a keen vision blessed the Marksman with a perfect aim, even in the most hostile conditions.
Working like a seasoned sculptor he meticolously shapes his creation, one precise strike after another. The final outcome is a grim tribute to death itself.
His blood and flesh turned into elemental fire. This incredibly powerful caster incinerates his enemies with a single gesture.
A gifted performer whose melodies inspire allies and mislead foes, turning the tides of a battle with a song or a whispered word.
Gifted with the magic of decay, antithesis of all that is holy. The Necromancer spells corrupt the flesh of his enemies and condemns them to an afterlife of servitude.
He adapted to darkness like a nocturnal animal. Campfire stories about them can make the night uneasy for any exploration team in foreign lands.
Halfway between mortal and divine, entire cults were born to worship this force of death. Its presence in the darkness is revealed only by the laments of its victims.
"Blending seamlessly with the night's terrain, in the cover of darkness, no human stands a chance against his ambush."
Ancient myths speak of Night Terrors, and how entire villages could vanish overnight because the wrong person was crossed.
Indistinguishable from the shadows that envelop its prey, every enemy—no matter how powerful—falls before they even sense its approach.
A ruthless ruler who respects no laws but his own. He will stop at nothing to eliminate his enemies and conquer rival kingdoms.
An elite warrior of the Holy Temple, a beacon of light to the oppressed, upholds and enforces the laws of the kingdom.
Equipped with one of the strongest venom known to humanity, she can propagate deadly illnesses among the enemy ranks.
An expert archer who studied the art of poison mixing, she imbues her arrows with an unknown substance capable of weakening enemies.

Blessed with ancient knowledge and divine powers, few recorded instances of Radiant Elders are present in history books. They are exceptional healers, said to be able to bring anyone back from the brink of death.
Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. Decades of training made this mage able to effortlessly wield fire magic to set his enemies ablaze.

Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. The Red Elder conjure meteors above the enemy ranks, dealing tremendous damage in a large area.

An experienced mage who can harness his powers to hurl fireballs into the enemy ranks. Can be often found in the ranks of defending armies, being a deterrent for any aggressor choosing to invade through an open field.
A master of lethality, he waits for the best moment to strike with incredible precision inflicting a grievous wound that hardly heals.
An outcast who resorts to petty crimes to survive. Lacking in strength and cunning, he compensates with his streetwise knowledge and resourcefulness.
The most skilled swordsman serving the royal family ascends to the role of Captain, overseeing palace security and determining the strategic tactics to be employed.
Commonly found in noble houses and palaces, these guards offer a balanced blend of offensive and defensive capabilities.
Highly trained in the art of swordsmanship, these guards are usually assigned to the protection of royal families and their palace.
A mythological entity who became one with the flame. The Scorched Elder conjures searing flames so powerful they can melt rocks, and crushes his enemies with the strength of a small star.
"A force of nature capable of reshaping the borders of kingdoms. It's said his devastating strikes can annihilate entire legions."
Specialized in concealment within the shadows, the Shadow Crawler can be very hard to hit in dark areas
Uses darkness as his hideout, and strike enemies when they least expect it.
A persuasive manipulator who bends hearts and minds, able to inspire his allies and push them over their limits.

"Acolytes, as full-fledged members of the Spire, have mastered the organization's secret technique. They are pivotal agents dispatched across the Realms, ensuring no target is beyond the reach of the Spire."

"The Spire, an age-old clandestine organization, recruits only the realm's most skilled assassins. Its select few members wield profound influence over the political landscape of kingdoms, capable of eliminating virtually any target with a secretive technique known solely to them."

"Upon the passing of the former Spire leader, often under circumstances far from the natural, the most experienced Acolyte is entrusted with assuming their role, and the organization's deepest secrets are revealed to them. Deployed only for exceptionally difficult tasks, and throughout history, they have been credited with toppling rulers and deities alike."
Spire Sages are those who advance the lethal techniques of the spire assassins. New Sages may not emerge for centuries, as the cynical resolve needed to pursue such knowledge is extremely uncommon.

"This one-of-a-kind assassin, gifted with unparalleled skill, can strike at the very essence of a being's consciousness, reaching beyond mere flesh. No living creature, mortal or divine, is safe from his dark art."
Displaying an incredible riding ability, Spitfang Riders managed to tame the fearsome Spitfang Snakes, a fearsome beast that can attack from a distance.
A master of archery, a Sureshot with a good positioning can take out even small groups of enemies all by herself.
Bane of invading armies, the Tempest will haul barrages of arrows shot with devastating strength and precision, singlehandedly defending strategic hideouts from entire regiments.
Among the strongest crusaders of the Holy Temple, the Templar serves as a commander of the vanguard that enforces the law in undiscovered lands.
A nimble outlaw whose skills are invaluable for detecting dangers well in advance.
An unbreakable warrior, renowned for traversing the chaos of battle unscathed. Whole armies have attempted, yet failed, to inflict even the slightest injury upon him.
The Toxic Stalker has perfected her art of creating deadly toxins, and can severely disrupt the activity of unaware hostile entities.
A cunning rogue who thrives on deception, adept at distracting foes and seizing unexpected opportunities in the chaos of battle.
A leader capable of unspeakable evil, he stands as the unrivaled champion in realms where only the mightiest prevail.

Most of those who aspire to become a Lich through the forgotten rituals realize too late they cannot pay the price required. The necromancer who begs for the release of death is confronted with a grim offer: his mortal body as an instrument for the entities he communed with.

A walking, impenetrable fortress clad in unbreakable battle gear. Deployed in epic battles to stabilize the frontline on newly conquered lands, he is able to withstand a full charge from opposing armies alone.
An infantry unit with some experience in the battlefield. Warriors constitutes the bulk of regular armies.
Mythological beings from whom the Spire assassins appear to draw their powers, they exist on the boundary between realms, slaying their prey through mysterious means.
Only the most experienced mages are given the title of Archmage. With their exceptional mastery of white magic, White Archmages are strategic units that can turn the tides of a battle.

Elders are mages regarded as masters of their art, keepers of dangerous secrets and wise enough to keep them as such. White elders unleash an unending stream of healing, making any frontline extremely resilient.
Widely used in the ranks of any army, white mages divisions provide reliable healing from the backlines to the most exposed soldiers.
Not indicated for beginner riders, wolves provide a formidable companion that can viciously bite enemies already overwhelmed by arrows.
An extremely vicious beast, the worg will tear apart the flesh of its enemies while his rider shoots with deadly aim.
"Unparalleled in the knowledge of anatomy, his enemies are a living canvas to him. While victim's realization rises with each stroke, his art comes to life while life comes to an end."

Gradually altered by constant exposure to various toxins, she has developed complete immunity to poison. This venomous demon slips through enemy towns under cover of night, hidden in shadows, leaving soldiers helpless before the coming invasion.

Wyrms are colossal, legendary creatures famed for the chaos they unleash in myths and folklore. These magical beasts possess elemental breath powerful enough to level entire towns, which led to them being relentlessly hunted in centuries past. No human has ever been known to ride a wyrm—except, perhaps, in the tales told by bards.

"You watched all the ads for today. As a gift, here are 10 extra Gems!"
"The coldest material ever forged makes up an armor that not only is incredibly resilient, but will FREEZE enemies on contact. FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."
Extremely durable armor made with the hardest known metal, lined with remains of prehistoric giants.
Heavy armor made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.
Incorporates a single, long Dryad hair that works as a powerful, permanent healing spell.

A forbidden artifact used to defy death merged with ancient, cursed metal. Serves as a decoy for the life of the wearer, restoring it with an enhanced version of the regular status every time they are hurt.
"Very hard plates made with the pirate's Black Iron make this armor difficult to break."
Armor made with alien Celestial Metal. Its superior properties grant an increase in protection from almost any armor crafted with metals found in the Realms.
"Further enhanced with part of the soul of the Primordial titan, this armor reached a perfect attunement with the wearer's mind."
A heavy armor made of copper held together with leather straps.
Heavy armor made from a metal dreamt by a powerful being. Its ethereal nature makes it less hard than its alternatives, but allows far more mobility.
"Living armor in a synchronic communication with the wearer's mind, greatly enhancing their reaction times."
Heavy armor padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
The hardest frostmetal coupled with trollskin paddings give this armor an extreme durability, while gifting the wearer with an increased regeneration.
"Enhanced with powerful ice magic, every attacker who touch this armor will be feeling its freezing nature. FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."
Heavy chest armor infused with an otherworldly substance, able to attract the enemies attention.
Standard, high quality equipment issued to the Empire Army soldiers.

"Incredibly hard and cold armor enhanced with rare reagents from the coldest mountains of the Realm. Will FREEZE attackers on contact. FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."
Iron rings woven together to confer basic protection in battle.
Armor donned by the leaders of the Crusade from the Eastern Kingdom, radiating light into the darkest corners of the Realms.
Shapeshifting spikes poke out from this armor when needed, orienting themselves towards attackers.
An incredibly resistant armor, coated with the flesh of a Slime God. Will grant an unmatched protection to the wearer.
Very heavy chest armor that grants the wearer with the highest levels of protection.
"Incredibly resistant armor made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal. While this material offers the best available protection, It may limit the wearer's mobility."
A golden armor adorned with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur, worn in social occasions by high ranking generals and diplomats.
Armor plated with the scales of an enormous behemoth, extremely heavy but capable of withstanding devastating blows.
Combines different types of elemental magic to provide an unbreakable defense, while neutering their individual elemental properties.
Armor enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
Heavy armor enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.
Protective armor made with sticky, green slime that can dissipate the force of any impact, lowering their effectiveness.
The skeleton of an undead monster, studded with very sharp spikes.
An ethereal swarm inhabits this armor, and will chew at the flesh of any enemy getting close enough.
Heavy armor made with the thick, resilient shell of a large tortoise.
Heavy chest armor made from undead remains.
The malignant aura surrounding this armor will harm any enemies daring to enter its range.
Bound within this ungodly cuirass by a potent spell, the seal of the Ten Hells burns fiercely, swiftly dissolving any foe bold enough to draw near.
Not fully understood in its properties, adding a void drop to an already stable mixture of elements seems to further enhance their properties, giving life to the hardest material known to exist.
Extremely light robe made with the remains of a prehistoric wing.

"A robe made with the wings of a Giant Moth treated to increase the normal amount of choking powder present by several orders of magnitude. Causes swelling in the airways of enemies getting too close, SILENCING them for 2 turns. SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"
"An apparently simple coat that belonged to the brightest mind of Kaunis. It increases the wearer attributes in an unknown way that doesn't rely on magic."
An intricate pattern made with magic chains is applied on a fire magic enhancing tunic, embedding the wearer in a protective field that reflects a part of the incoming force.
A light robe made of cloth derived from plants.
The velvet infused with deep sea reagents used in the weaving of this robe confers it enhanced protection against external elements.
An ethereal robe woven from cloth dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices resistance to grant a better intelligence improvement.
An unknown light, elastic material sewn in the shape of a robe. Offers great protection, without hindering the wearer mobility, which is vital for spellcasting.
Woven with Velvet imported by pirates, these robes are sought after by all the mages and nobles in the highest spheres.
A light robe made of feathers, displaying the color of the desert birds.
Light robe made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
Light cloak made from ghastly fabric mixed with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.
Extremely resistant robe woven from cloth employed by Kaunis elite troops. Grants increased protection to the wearer, but the lack of magic used in its making will reduce the boost to intelligence.
Light and versatile robe woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox.
Resistant but very light robe made from the wings of a Giant Moth.
A robe enchanted with powerful protection spells, usually worn by members of the High Council of Larox.
A preserved, ancient robe taken from the cold body of a slain Lich. The blueprints for its making are now lost in time. Grants enhanced powers to the undead caster if its servants are alive.
Cloak enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
Garment made with precious fabric, provides little protection but grants a wide range of movements.
Peculiar light equipment that sacrifices mobility to grant increased protection.
Cloak made with mysterious, ethereal fabric of unknown origin.
Made entirely with Giant Spider silk, whose elasticity and resistance is unparalleled.
Slime robe infused with a fiery artifact. Maintains its original properties while granting better control over fire magic.
"Adding a fireproof coating to this unique robe allows to apply different enchantments during its crafting, since protection from it's own fiery power is no longer needed."
"The peculiar properties of the troll's Wintercloth allows to craft this very light albeit resilient light clothing"
Enhanced with real Snow Wyvern scales, this robe allows for an enhanced channeling of white magic.
Extremely versatile jacket made with the remains of prehistoric giants.
"Made of resilient Banshee scales, one of the hardest known organic materials that can bend enough to not reduce the wearer's mobility too much."

Elite armor embedding several fiery gems. It has a great versatility in combat, and grants increased control on domesticated creatures. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.
Crafted from the belts in use by the Golden City Wardens, this equipment is surprisingly resilient despite its improvised nature.
Simple jacket padded with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.

"This armor components, harmonized by a central magical seal to build the most disruptive interference, modifies the properties of the air around to make transmission of sound impossible, hindering spellcasters effectiveness. SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"
"This armor components can vibrate so fast they disrupt the propagation of sound in the air, making spellcasters unable to cast their spells. SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"
Made with an ancient metal with unique properties, makes deep wounds inflicted by the wearer hurt even more.
Hides processed with reagents gathered in the depth of the ocean, to confer the wearer additional protection against external elements.
Jacket assembled from materials dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices defense to grant a superior mobility to the wearer.
Jacket padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.
Belt jacket enhanced with precious Ivory.
A simple jacket made of leather.
Very flexible and resilient armor made with monkey hides.
Jacket made from a monster mutated through the use of alien technology. Extremely resistant at the cost of a lower mobility.
Made with a type of leather that comes from giant bats rarely found in very deep caverns, allows for superior mobility and protection.
Jacket enhanced with a powerful rune through the manipulation of its ethereal aspect, often achieved using a powerful instrument.
Jacket enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.
The legendary Veil, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. It autonomously helps the wearer in its movements in a deadly synergy.

Legends talk about unseen assassins wearing this Veil who were able to take over entire armies. Gifted from an ancient God to allow their worshippers to pursue its goals, only a few shreds of these artifacts exist by now, displaced all around the Realms.
Padded jacket enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.
Dissipate the force of incoming blows very effectively, but sacrifices some mobility.
Jacket made from a very resistant type of leather, produced by magical means.
"Made entirely with Spitfang's scales and padded with fabric made by Moth wings. Will allow for great mobility while offering extremely good protection."
Hard as stone while allowing for a wide range of movements, secretes an oil that hastens the healing of wounds.
Grim piece of equipment made with undead remains. Offers good protection against external attacks maintaining some mobility.
Made with wurm scales for increased integrity, padded with feathers.

Followers of this doctrine believe that suffering is synonymous with strength. They willingly inject themselves with an unknown pathogen that brings unrelenting agony and an insatiable thirst for blood. Over time, they have adapted to endure—and even revel in—the torment of their decaying flesh.

Adherents of the Doctrine of Control seek absolute dominance over themselves and others. They refine techniques to manipulate their enemies by commanding the elements and wield powerful abilities that grant them access to even the most guarded minds.
Status Effects and Status Effects resistance.

Adherents of the Doctrine of Fortitude regard resilience as the ultimate virtue. They subject their bodies to relentless physical trials, pushing themselves to the brink of destruction and beyond. Through sheer determination and unyielding discipline, they transform pain and exhaustion into unshakable strength, forging a will as unbreakable as steel.

Followers of the Doctrine of Grace are devoted to aiding the injured and the afflicted. They reject violence as a path to power, dedicating themselves instead to alleviating pain and suffering and bringing comfort to those around them.

"Adherents of the Doctrine of Illusion devote themselves to mastering the art of deception. They see reality as malleable, shaped not by truth but by perception. To them, control over one's subjective judgment is the key to true power."

Followers of this doctrine are jack-of-all-trades, seeking to gain expertise in as many fields as possible. They believe that true power lies in the pursuit of pure knowledge, with its practical application being a secondary—though undeniably valuable—tool.

\"Attack is the best defense\" is the creed of those who follow the Doctrine of Ruin. They swiftly unleash the full potential of their destructive power, paying little to no regards to their own safety.
Damage at the expense of safety.

"Adherents of the Doctrine of War revere conflict as the ultimate crucible for growth and dominance. They dedicate their lives to mastering the art of combat, honing their bodies into lethal weapons. For them, battle is not just a means to an end but a sacred pursuit where strength, strategy, and unrelenting willpower define one's worth."

Data is saved to cloud every hour. Loading from cloud will restore your most recent backup. The app will close, and when you reopen it you will find everything that was saved. This operation is not reversible."

"When adventurers lose all their HP in a dungeon, they faint.
When one adventurer faint, they lose 20% of the total experience towards the next level (this does not happen in raids and epic raids).
When all adventurers faint, they will lose all progress towards the next areas and respawn with full HP after 18 seconds."

At the bottom of the Adventurers tab, there is a small arrow pointing up. You can tap it to open a menu that lets you dismiss or reorder your adventurers. After you dismiss an adventurer, if you change your mind, you have 24 hours to recall them from \"Recall adventurers\" in the drawer menu.

"Epic Raids are like regular Raids, with the following differences:
• An Epic Raid has memory of your previous runs. If you win a fight once, you will not encounter it again.
• When you finish the Epic Raid and collect all loot, which will contain powerful unique items, it will disappear forever."
The progress will continue while the app is closed without any difference. The only limit to this progress is that it goes on for a maximum of 12 hours.

"Raids are harder challenges similar to Dungeons, but with a few differences:
• Only one try per day. More can be purchased with gems.
• The allowed team size is a minimum of 5, but can be greater.
• Experience is not lost on death.
• On death or completion the team will automatically exit the Raid.
Tap on \"Raids\" at the bottom of the screen to see the unlocked raid!"
